title: feat(rest): serve the anonymous restriction profile os validate --target reads (ADR-0138 D2 amendment)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DDxdrYJq965rUfrZBso8FS3)_
Fixes #34774
Clause-②: yes — widening: one new anonymous read-only discovery route (an open restriction profile); nothing served today changes
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：自托管服务器的开发者用命令行校验工程时，可以直接指向自己的服务器地址读取它的限制配置（开放、无限制，附带它运行的规范版本），以前这一步对自托管服务器总是失败。
- 为什么做：属于 MCP 本地优先编写入口那条主线，补上“对自托管服务器校验”的后一半；你在决策卡（自托管服务器能否不登录公开限制配置）上选了 A。
- 出错会怎样：未登录的人只能多读到一个规范版本号，不涉及任何业务数据；关掉服务器的发现功能就一并隐藏；随时可以撤回。
- 要你做什么：这次改动修订了访客模型那篇架构决策记录，需要你本人批准后才能合并。

## What changes

Face 3 of #34774, resumed under the maintainer's ruling **A** on decision card #35848 (recorded on the card in comment 7043884056; card #35848 is resolved by the seat when this merges). Faces 1 and 2 landed in PR #35838 as `Part of #34774`; this PR closes the card.

- **The route** (`packages/rest/src/discovery-routes.ts`): `GET {basePath}/discovery/restriction-profile`, ported unchanged in behaviour from the parked branch `claude/area-a4C-34774-route` @ `c7890e5b` (main had not moved the four files since that branch's base). It is anonymous (no `enforceAuth`, as `/discovery`), refuses every query parameter (`refuseUnknownQueryParams(req, res, [])` → 400 `VALIDATION_ERROR`), answers 503 `SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` when the `@objectstack/spec` manifest cannot be read, serves `{ success: true, data }` with `data` an open `RestrictionProfileSchema` value and `versions { spec, skills }`, and is mounted inside `registerDiscoveryEndpoints`, so `api.enableDiscovery` gates it. The docblock is corrected per review note N4 of 7038862149: the anonymous peer is `/discovery`'s `version`, not the MCP `initialize` text, and it now cites the ADR-0138 D2 amendment.
- **One `REST_ROUTE_LEDGER` row** (`family: 'discovery'`, `disposition: 'server-only'`; the CLI reads it, not `@objectstack/client`).
- **Behaviour pin flipped in place:** `rest-config-mount-table.pin.test.ts`, `api.enableDiscovery` off removes 2 routes → 3 routes (the new one added), ruled by #34774 face 3 and #35848 A.
- **ADR-0138 D2 amendment** (`docs/adr/0138-…md`), in the invitation-preview amendment's form and place: a `· **Amended** (2026-11-20, …)` entry on the status line, and a dated note under D2's table after the 2026-11-16 note. It admits the route, and its environment-scoped twin where scoping mounts it, into the control-plane **discovery** role; names the carrier (the anonymous-door sweep's `discovery` row only, no `ALLOW_ROUTES` row, because the handler never calls `enforceAuth`); says what it serves (a constant open profile; the one added anonymous fact is the spec version, which `/discovery`'s `version` states too unless an operator stamp replaces it); gives the reason (`os validate --target URL` without a credential, plus cloud parity, #31240 comment 6716619631); and cites ruling A on #35848 and the review record 7038862149. Nothing else in the ADR changes. The generated ADR index is unchanged (`pnpm check:adr-index` exit 0; the index row shows the status line's opening only).
- **Sweep classification** (`packages/qa/dogfood/test/anonymous-door-sweep.classification.ts`): the `discovery` outside family's `routeIs(…)` gains `GET /api/v1/discovery/restriction-profile`, and its reason names the amendment. It is edited in the same commit as the amendment, as the header requires.
- **Changeset** `.changeset/34774-restriction-profile-route.md`: `'@objectstack/rest': patch`. `@objectstack/dogfood` is private, so it takes none.

### Clause-② reading

`yes — widening`. The diff adds one GET route at a path nothing served before (the CLI's `RESTRICTION_PROFILE_ROUTE` got a 404 from every self-hosted runtime). No existing route, schema, export, error code or default changes. The new answer for an anonymous caller is a 200 where the ADR's everything-else class answered 401, which is exactly what the ruled amendment admits. No published `exports`, spec shape or authorable key changes, so `Metadata-protocol: none` and `patch`.

## Tests

<details><summary>rest: full suite, typecheck, and the three route files at ccc73c866</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest test` (under the verify lock, after a full `pnpm build`): `Test Files 424 passed (424)`, `Tests 8648 passed | 351 skipped (8999)`; lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest --filter @objectstack/dogfood typecheck`: lock `VERDICT command-exit 0` (rest's `tsc --noEmit` plus `check:test-typecheck`; dogfood's `tsc --noEmit`).
- Targeted, verbose: `discovery-schema-conformance.test.ts`, `rest-config-mount-table.pin.test.ts`, `rest-route-ledger.conformance.test.ts`: `Test Files 3 passed (3)`, `Tests 54 passed (54)`, including "api.enableDiscovery: on → mounted, off → exactly 3 route(s) gone", "answers { success: true, data } on both mounts…" and "reads no query parameter: an unknown one is refused 400 VALIDATION_ERROR".

</details>

<details><summary>The anonymous-door sweep, run locally on the booted showcase, plus a one-time ablation</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 test/anonymous-door-sweep.dogfood.test.ts`: `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 21 passed (21)`; lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`. This is the merge-group battery file that review F1 said would go red; PR CI skips it.
- Ablation (one time, not kept): `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the new `routeIs` key with an unmatched one (anchor x1 → x0, blob `8f35c855bae2` → `f861b4156a21`). The everything-else case went red, `Tests 1 failed | 20 passed (21)`, with exactly one route in that class: this one. So the route is in the swept population and the new key is what classifies it. Restored: blob == HEAD `8f35c855bae2`, `git diff HEAD` empty. A first attempt was a no-op that the tool refused before running anything (its replacement text already occurred in the file), so it measured nothing.
- The environment-scoped twin: the sweep's showcase boot does not enable environment scoping, and the ablation's red named only the unscoped route, so the row lists that route alone. The ADR amendment admits the twin where scoping mounts it.

</details>

## Verification

**Real boot** (after a full `pnpm build`, the way round 1 did): `pnpm dev:crm -- --fresh -p 38775`, then

- anonymous `curl http://127.0.0.1:38775/api/v1/discovery/restriction-profile` → `HTTP 200`, body `{"success":true,"data":{"allowCode":true,"allowSandboxedJs":true,"allowScheduledAutomation":true,"allowedFlowNodeTypes":[…23 node types…],"versions":{"spec":"18.6.0","skills":"18.6.0"}}}`;
- the same URL with `?x=1` → `HTTP 400`; control: anonymous `GET /api/v1/data/account` → `HTTP 401`;
- `os validate --target http://127.0.0.1:38775` in `examples/app-crm` → exit 0, printed `Target profile: http://127.0.0.1:38775/api/v1/discovery/restriction-profile` and `✓ Validation passed`.

The server was torn down by its recorded pid and port.

**Two-minute check:** boot any example (`pnpm dev:crm -- --fresh -p PORT`) and `curl -i http://127.0.0.1:PORT/api/v1/discovery/restriction-profile` with no credential. Expect 200 and the open profile with the spec version.

**Read first, by risk:**
1. `docs/adr/0138-…md`, the new dated note under D2: the governed text, and the carrier statement (sweep row only, no `ALLOW_ROUTES`).
2. `packages/rest/src/discovery-routes.ts`, the route handler: no `enforceAuth`, the empty closed query set, the 503 branch.
3. `packages/qa/dogfood/test/anonymous-door-sweep.classification.ts`, the `discovery` row.

<details><summary>Gates at ccc73c866</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 83 commands at ccc73c866. Each was run with its exit captured before any pipe: 83 exit 0. `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` first exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: its pinned control commit `621a4876` was not in this shallow clone); after `git fetch --depth=1 origin 621a4876…` it exited 0 with "48 cases pass", and that exit is the one recorded.
- `--ran` reconciliation: "83 derived, 83 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN", exit 0.
- `node scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs --branch=claude/area-a4C-34774-face3`: `VERDICT clean exit 0` (origin/main merges cleanly; #35865 shares the ledger and the mount-table pin and merges cleanly).
- Not run locally: `test:repo` and the full CI farm; CI owns them.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Landing is Tier H** (`docs/adr/**`, Prime Directive #14): this PR lands only by the maintainer's hand or an authorized approval, after the seat's CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER review. Never readied, queued or labelled by a seat.
- The `discovery` outside family keeps no `expect` predicate: D2 states no answer for it, and the classification header forbids pinning one route's own answer. A 200 is accepted there as it is for the REST root; the everything-else red in the ablation is what pins the classification.
- Size: 11 files, +268 / −13 against the merge-base (round 3 alone: 8 files, +98 / −12, net 86).

## Round 3 (seat S1/S2)

Answers the seat contract review [7062697033](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/35887#issuecomment-7062697033) (S1, S2, nits a and b) under claim amendment 3 (7062738586). Nit c is a CLI-lane card and is not here.

- **S1, route (b), text only.** The body stays the constant open profile ruling A admitted. The ADR-0138 dated D2 note and the docblock of `openRestrictionProfile` now say plainly: `allowedFlowNodeTypes` is the profile's whole node-type vocabulary, the approvals plugin's `approval` / `approval_revise` included. It is not a statement of which plugins this kernel runs, so `os validate --target` against a self-hosted runtime does not check whether an approval flow has an executor there. The spec-side reader rule goes to spec-lane card #36081. Neither the body nor the ruling's scope moves.
- **S2, the CJS manifest anchor.** New `packages/rest/tsup.config.ts`: the shared root config's settings unchanged (same entry, formats, dts, target, sourcemap, sources-content drop), plus `shims: true`, with a LOAD-BEARING comment in the shape of `packages/mcp/tsup.config.ts`. `packages/rest/package.json`'s `build` script drops `--config ../../tsup.config.ts` so tsup reads the package config (one line; without it the new file would never be read). Measured on the rebuilt `dist/index.cjs`: 0 occurrences of an emptied `var import_meta = {}` (was 2 under the ablation below), and the `getImportMetaUrl` shim is present. This also repairs `loadOpenApiSpec` in `rest-server.ts`, which spells the same `createRequire(import.meta.url)` and could not read the static OpenAPI artifact through the `require` entry. The changeset says both.
- **Pins.** (a) The 503 branch: a fresh module graph (`vi.resetModules`) with `module`'s `createRequire` failing only for `@objectstack/spec/package.json` → `503`, `code: SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE` (the flat `sendDeclaredFault` dialect), no `data`. (b) Both formats: a second `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` behaviour probe, on `@objectstack/rest`, serves the route through the public `RestServer` from `dist/index.cjs` and `dist/index.js` and requires both to answer the installed `@objectstack/spec` version. The probe table gains an optional `call` (a function source, awaited), with one new self-test case; the AGREES battery floor moves 5 → 6.
- **Nits.** (a) `RESTRICTION_PROFILE_PARAMS`, an exported empty closed set, replaces the inline `[]`. (b) ADR-0138 criterion 2's discovery-documents item and the `discovery-routes.ts` anchor invariant now name the route.

**Version disclosure.** `/discovery` answers its anonymous `version` as the `OS_RUNTIME_VERSION` stamp when one is set, otherwise the `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` package version. `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` and `@objectstack/spec` are in one `fixed` changeset group, so without a stamp the two numbers are the same on any install that resolves one release of the platform; they differ only on an install that resolves the two packages at different versions, or where the manifest read fails (`/discovery` then says `unknown`, and this route answers 503). With a stamp set, they differ: this route exposes the exact `@objectstack/spec` version, which `/discovery` does not.
**Ruled A: keep the exact version.** The maintainer chose A on the version-disclosure decision card on 2026-11-21 (Ruling-ref: #34774 comment 7065230616): `versions.spec` / `versions.skills` stay the exact resolved `@objectstack/spec` version, as implemented. Trimming to major.minor was not chosen: `RestrictionProfileSchema` requires SemVer 2.0.0 and `restrictionProfileVersionDrift` compares by string equality, and an operator who wants the route hidden already has `api.enableDiscovery: false`. No docs sentence about `OS_RUNTIME_VERSION` is added.

The full scan exits 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET: not every package is built in this worktree), so the shipped probe table was run through the gate's own exported `runBehaviourProbes` on the two built entries it names (`@objectstack/rest`, `@objectstack/metadata-core`): `findings: [], ran: 2`. Restored: blob == HEAD `a87f404dab54`, `git diff HEAD` empty; rebuilt; preflight (present mode) → marker in `dist/index.cjs`, tree clean; probe `findings: []`. The preflight's tree reading refused on the mutate leg (the source spells `shims: true`, the dist marker differs); the dist reading is the one recorded.
